title: 第15章 管事为难第16章 击杀野猪
content_zh:
;;
王管事那眼神，像冰冷的针，扎得陈平心头一紧。
他快速挪开视线，像往常一样走向堆放背篓的地方。
王管事没说话，也没动，就那么站着，直到陈平背起篓子和其他杂役一起走向野草地。
这天干活，陈平明显感觉到气氛不同了。
监工的鞭子在他头顶上空晃悠的次数多了起来，抽打旁边动作慢的杂役时，鞭梢也故意往他这边带，好几次差点抽到他。
王管事背着手在野草地里踱步，那双小眼睛时不时就落在他身上，带着审视和一种说不出的阴沉。
陈平心里绷着一根弦。他不敢再显露力气，割草的速度放慢了些，背草也只背大半篓。
但即便如此，他完成自己那份活计的时间，还是比周围人快了不少。
他只能尽量找角落缩着休息，避开王管事的视线。
然而，躲是躲不过的。
下午，清理猪圈。
陈平正费力地把一桶猪粪拖到倾倒点，王管事慢悠悠地踱了过来，停在他面前。
“陈平！”
王管事的声音不高，但周围的嘈杂似乎都压了下去。
“我看你最近精神头不错嘛，力气也见长。”
陈平放下粪桶，低着头。
“回管事，是您管教得好，小的不敢偷懒。”
“呵！”
王管事嗤笑一声，油亮的脸上没什么表情。

“不敢偷懒？我看你是挺勤快。既然这么有劲头，那…北坡那片林子边上的猪圈，你去清理干净。”
陈平心里咯噔一下。
北坡？
那片林子靠近后山，偏僻得很。
最关键的是，那附近野猪出没！
前几个月就有个倒霉的杂役，去那边清理时被野猪顶死了，肠子都流了一地。
后来那猪圈就一直没人敢去，里面的粪污堆积如山，臭气熏天，还盘踞着不少蛇虫鼠蚁，成了真正的凶地。
“管…管事！”
陈平嗓子发干。
“北坡那边…听说不太平，有野猪…”
“怕了？”

The look in Manager Wang's eyes was like a cold needle, which made Chen Ping's heart tighten.
He quickly looked away and walked towards the place where the backpacks were stacked as usual.
Manager Wang didn't say anything or move, and just stood there until Chen Ping picked up the basket and walked to the grassland with other handymen.
While working this day, Chen Ping clearly felt that the atmosphere was different.
The overseer's whip was swinging over his head more often. When he was whipping the slow-moving handyman next to him, the tip of the whip was also deliberately brought towards him, almost hitting him several times.
Manager Wang was pacing in the wild grass with his hands behind his back, and his small eyes would fall on him from time to time, with scrutiny and an indescribable gloominess.
Chen Ping felt nervous in his heart. He did not dare to show off his strength anymore, so he cut the grass at a slower pace, and he could only carry most of the basket of grass on his back.
But even so, he still completed his part of the work much faster than the people around him.
He could only try to find a corner to huddle up and rest, avoiding Manager Wang's sight.
However, there is no way to hide.
In the afternoon, clean the pig pen.
Chen Ping was struggling to drag a bucket of pig manure to the dumping point when Manager Wang slowly walked over and stopped in front of him.
"Chen Ping!"
Manager Wang's voice was not loud, but the noise around him seemed to be suppressed.
"I think you've been in good spirits lately, and your strength has improved."
Chen Ping put down the dung bucket and lowered his head.
"Return to the manager, you have disciplined me well. The little ones don't dare to be lazy."
"Ha!"
Manager Wang sneered, his shiny face expressionless.
"Don't you dare to be lazy? I think you are quite diligent. Since you are so energetic, then... go and clean up the pigsty on the edge of the forest on the north slope."
Chen Ping's heart skipped a beat.
North slope?
The forest is close to the back mountain and is very remote.
The most important thing is that there are wild boars nearby!
A few months ago, there was an unlucky handyman who was gored to death by a wild boar when he went to clean up there. His intestines were spilled all over the floor.
Later, no one dared to go to the pigsty. The excrement piled up like a mountain, the stench was overwhelming, and there were many snakes, insects, rats, and ants entrenched inside, making it a real dangerous place.
"Taking care of... taking care of things!"
Chen Ping's throat felt dry.
"The north slope...I heard it's not peaceful, there are wild boars..."
"Afraid?"
